sources.prompt: Production 2D hand drawn game enemy animation SPRITE SHEET. Transparent background true alpha. EXACT regular grid 4 columns x 6 rows, all cells equal, no text no labels no weapons no ground shadows. 24 isolated full-body sprites. Each ROW same unique enemy with FOUR frames LEFT to RIGHT: neutral idle eyes open; breathing idle eyes squeezed shut blink; locomotion left foot forward; locomotion right foot forward. Maintain same scale, same center and foot baseline per cell, generous transparent padding 15%, no overlap. Six rows: row1 spiky soot-black dust imp with one hot coral red ring eye; row2 hunched dark navy ink slug with two angry crimson slits and paper teeth; row3 jagged aubergine magnetic brute with chipped horseshoe crown and crimson eyes; row4 black wax puddle creature with melted angular cap and tiny red pin eyes; row5 dark violet curtain ghost triangular ragged lower hem and sharp red eyes; row6 hulking charcoal shadow clerk with torn collar and red diamond eyes. Original designs for Arcane Brigade lost-object nightmare world, NOT copyrighted characters. Enemy visual grammar: 85% dark blue/black silhouette, sparse bright red/pink focal eyes, jagged/pointed silhouettes, NOT friendly rounded pastel toy or humanoid allies. SIMPLE extremely readable small-scale 2D cartoon, bold clean outline and 2-value hand painted cel shading, minimal small detail. Animate the SHAPE and limbs visibly between frames, not identical copies. No arms or hands, only body + tiny feet. Flat frontal slightly 3/4 view, consistent orthographic camera. Crisp polished raster illustration.
sources.notes: True alpha confirmed; some empty corner alpha1/255 tolerated <=3, not chroma-key. Background-removal retry was not selected because same alpha behavior. Six base enemy forms; boss variants reuse these animations, not five bespoke boss sheets.

Orthographic front slight3/4 same design same size same center same feet baseline. No arms, no hands, no weapon attached, no shadows, no text or labels. All sprites completely isolated, each in equal cell, generous transparent15%padding, don't overlap. Hand drawn clean bold dark outlines, rich but simple cel shading with sparse highlights.
